what: An accent color plate covers the screen and a three-row grid (each row min 14rem·20vh) turns on in .5s. A thin line atop each row draws from the left, .1s later per row (.75s cubic-bezier(.5,0,0,1)), and text lines rise from 110% below in 1.15s expo.out (.1s gaps), while small text lights in .75s after .5s. After the hold seconds, row heights open to 20·60·20vh (25·50·25svh below 1000px) in 1s, the center title swells to 20% of the screen width in 1.2s, and the top and bottom lines turn off in 1s. Once fully swollen, the plate rises half a screen in 1.2s while its lower half is clipped in 1s and darkens to .5 brightness. During the same 1s the page rises from below the screen and follows the plate’s lower edge.

options.page: Page CSS (e.g. .site) that rises from below when the panel lifts away — if empty, the page stays in place
options.hold: Seconds to wait after the text lines are set and before inflating, default 1 — the original waits until the hero photos finish loading (progress 1s power4.out)
options.size: Swollen title size (% of screen width), default 20
options.swell · lift · rise: Durations in seconds for swelling, panel rising and clipping, and page rising, default 1.2 · 1.2 · 1
options.wide: Reference width for wide screens (px), default 1000 — narrower than that, line heights become 25·50·25
options.--fx-fill · --fx-ink · --fx-line: Fill color, text color, line color, defaults --kf-accent · --kf-on-accent · --kf-contrast-ink
options.[data-fx-part=row]: Line — a rule is drawn above it (the last line also gets one below)
options.[data-fx-part=title]: Title (one line). Rises from below like a line of text
options.[data-fx-part=split]: Text that rises from below line by line
options.[data-fx-part=fade]: Small text that only turns on — delayed .1s per sibling order
options.fx:lift · fx:done: Fires on the panel when it starts lifting and when fully lifted (bubbles up to the document) — then opens the hero photo
